newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel eyes 129.80 if audit displeases.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel eyes 129.80 if audit displeases.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF will head towards support at 129.80 if the market dislikes the results of the French audit, technical analysts said on Monday.
Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn and junior budget minister Christian Sautter hold a news conference to present results of the audit and any ensuing budget measures at 0830 GMT.

"We've got key support at 130.32/34," Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking said. "That's colossal congestion. If we don't' hold that we're going to have another drift back towards the lows."
September notionnel were quoted at 130.34 at 0701 GMT, down two basis points from Friday's settlement.
Techncial analysts said initial support would come in around last Thursday's low of 130.26. Ostwald said a stronger buffer arrived at 129.80, the low from July 15.
"If it doesn't like it (the audit) at all then there's some congestion between 129.42/44 from earlier in the month," he said.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deustche Morgan Grenfell in London, saw initial support at 130.10, congestion on hourly charts.
"We still have a bearish cross on stochastics from a couple of weeks ago which is weighing on the market," she said.
She put retracement support at 129.74 and an Elliott Wave target at 129.54.
On the upside, Miller had minor trendline resistance at 130.52 and then a stronger trendline at 130.78.
If the audit is well received, both Ostwald and Miller said notionnel would aim for the contract high at 130.88.
September Pibor futures were quoted at 96.49, down one basis point from Friday. Analysts said the momentum picture remained bearish with downside targets at 96.40 over the next few days.
